svg.title: Hydrogen energy levels and spectral series
svg.desc: Hydrogen’s energy levels drawn to scale: −13.6 eV for n = 1, −3.40 eV for n = 2, −1.51 eV for n = 3, −0.85 eV for n = 4, −0.54 eV for n = 5, up to 0 for n = ∞. Downward arrows show transitions ending on n = 1 (the Lyman series), on n = 2 (the Balmer series) and on n = 3 (the Paschen series). An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Hydrogen energy gaps produce separate Balmer lines
Selected transitions n = 3, 4, 5, 6 → 2. The atom occupies discrete energy levels; the arrow marks
the energy gap, not intermediate allowed energies or a spatial electron path.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
